sloka: तस्यादर्शनजः शोकः सुतस्याप्रतिकर्मणः ।उच्चोषयति मे प्राणान्वारि स्तोकमिवातवः ॥२-६४-६८॥
transliteration: tasyādarśanajaḥ śokaḥ sutasyāpratikarmaṇaḥ ।uccoṣayati me prāṇānvāri stokamivātavaḥ ॥2-64-68॥

translations.english: My grief in the absence of Rama of peerless deeds is drying up my life as heat dries up small pools of water.
